GPU code can now use Rust's portable SIMD. We share the implementation approach and what this unlocks for GPU programming.

At VectorWare, we are building the first GPU-native software company. Today, we are excited to announce that we can successfully use Rust's portable SIMD (core::simd) on the GPU. This milestone marks a significant step towards our vision of enabling developers to write complex, high-performance applications that leverage the full power of GPU hardware using familiar Rust abstractions.

Parallelism below the thread

When we brought Rust threads to the GPU, we mapped each std::thread to a GPU warp. This let us run many concurrent threads on the GPU but did not use the parallel lanes within each thread/warp.

On the CPU, the abstraction for parallelism within a thread is SIMD. A single instruction operates on several data elements packed into a vector unit: where scalar code adds two numbers, a SIMD add takes two vectors of, say, eight f32 values and produces eight sums at once. This data parallelism is inside a single thread, below the level where the operating system schedules anything.

Rust's portable SIMD

Historically, writing SIMD in Rust meant reaching for the architecture-specific vendor intrinsics in core::arch, such as _mm256_add_ps on x86-64 or vaddq_f32 on Arm. These intrinsics are specific to a single instruction set, so a program that runs on more than one architecture needs a separate implementation for each.

Rust's portable SIMD instead adds a layer of abstraction above these intrinsics. It provides a single generic type Simd<T, N> that represents a vector of N elements of type T. A program writes its arithmetic, comparisons, reductions, and lane shuffles once against Simd and the compiler lowers them to whatever vector instructions the target CPU has.

At VectorWare, we realized the GPU is just one more piece of vector hardware for portable SIMD to target. As a bonus, portable SIMD lives in core rather than std and it does not even need the std support we brought to the GPU.

SIMT is SIMD

GPUs execute in a model NVIDIA calls SIMT, or Single Instruction, Multiple Thread. A warp issues one instruction, and each of its 32 lanes runs that instruction on its own data. One instruction operating on many data elements is exactly what SIMD means, and the per-lane addressing that SIMT adds does not change that. A warp is a wide vector unit and a portable SIMD vector maps onto that unit directly.

For example, a Simd<i16, 32> gives one i16 element to each of the warp's 32 lanes, and adding two such vectors compiles to a single warp instruction in which every lane adds its element at once.

This new mapping completes the parallelism hierarchy from our earlier work. On the CPU, a thread contains SIMD lanes, and on the GPU our std::thread is a warp whose hardware lanes play the same role. In both cases, core::simd drives those lanes.

A world first: core::simd on the GPU

As with our earlier posts, this is hard to show visually because the code is ordinary Rust. The same core::simd types that lower to x86-64 SIMD on a laptop lower to warp operations on the GPU, with no change to the source.

Here we define a small portable SIMD routine and call it from main. It exercises the core features of the model: elementwise arithmetic, a comparison that produces a lane mask, a select driven by that mask, and a horizontal reduction across lanes.

The entry point is a normal fn main with no GPU-specific annotations. Our toolchain compiles it to a GPU kernel, and the result is printed from the device using our std support.

Below is a recording of the program running on the GPU, producing the exact same output as running it on the CPU.

Implementation

As previously mentioned, the mapping rests on a single observation: a warp is a vector unit whose lanes are individually addressable. Once Simd<T, N> is laid out per lane, each family of operations has a direct warp-level counterpart.

SIMD elementwise operations are the easy case. Addition, multiplication, comparison, and the other lane-wise operators come from ordinary Rust trait implementations on Simd such as Add. The GPU runs them natively.

SIMD reductions such as reduce_sum and reduce_max combine every lane into a scalar. These use the GPU's warp shuffle instructions to exchange and combine values across lanes, producing the same scalar result in every lane.

SIMD cross-lane shuffles, such as simd_swizzle! and rotates, move elements between lanes. Because a SIMD lane is a GPU warp lane, these map onto the same warp shuffle primitives that make GPU lanes so good at exchanging data.

SIMD masks map just as cleanly. A Mask<T, N> gives one predicate to each SIMD lane. Mask::select performs a selection in every warp lane. Horizontal mask queries such as any and all use GPU vote and ballot instructions.

Scalar values in the surrounding code, such as a loop counter or a constant, are computed identically by every lane and so are simply replicated across the warp just like in ordinary CUDA. This is the same uniform-versus-varying distinction that data-parallel languages like ISPC make explicit, except here it falls out of Rust's own types: a plain f32 is uniform, a Simd<f32, 32> is varying.

Working with lanes

The one place the abstraction and the hardware do not line up is lane count. On the CPU a Simd<T, N> allows any N from 1 through 64, but GPU hardware has a fixed width: 32 lanes on NVIDIA and 32 or 64 on AMD. The mapping is one to one only when N matches that width. A smaller N leaves some lanes idle while a larger N gives some or all lanes more than one element to process.

When there is more work than the warp is wide, we need a way to say which lanes do what. It helps to think of the warp as a small "machine" of its own: a fixed set of primitives for moving and combining data across lanes, plus invariants about which lanes are active and how much data each one holds. "Programming" it means placing work onto lanes within those rules.

At VectorWare, we give that machine an IR. Rather than a standalone data structure, we encode it in Rust's type system using types, generics, const generics, and trait bounds. A program is composed of typed operations: ballots, shuffles, reductions, scans, gathers, scatters, atomics, and strip mining for vectors wider than the warp. Operands, execution shape, and capacity are typed too. Because the operations carry their shape in the types, many invalid programs cannot be constructed at all.

The IR needs no interpreter on the GPU. Each operation lowers straight to the corresponding instructions with zero cost over hand-written PTX. The same types let us run it on the CPU too. We built a reference interpreter that executes the IR deterministically, a kind of Miri for warp-lane programming. We use it to simulate GPU code and for differential testing.

Our work targets NVIDIA today, but nothing here is CUDA specific. AMD wavefronts and Vulkan subgroups expose similar primitives and semantics. The IR itself is architecture-agnostic Rust.

Benefits

The same source runs on the CPU and the GPU. Code and libraries that already use portable SIMD become candidates for GPU execution without a rewrite.

Unmodified CPU code can use GPU lane-level parallelism. GPU-aware code can still go further by using core::arch intrinsics that map directly to PTX.

A Simd<T, N> is an ordinary owned value. The borrow checker, lifetimes, and type checking apply to it exactly as they do on the CPU. We are not adding a GPU-specific vector type or a new set of annotations. We are mapping Rust's existing portable SIMD onto the GPU's native execution model. At VectorWare, we are making GPUs behave like a normal Rust platform.

Downsides

Portable SIMD is still unstable in Rust. It requires the nightly #![feature(portable_simd)], and its surface may change before it stabilizes.

Vectors narrower than the warp leave lanes idle, and vectors wider than the warp turn each operation into more instructions. The abstraction is only zero cost when the vector width matches the number of warp lanes.

Not every cross-lane operation maps to an efficient warp instruction. Shuffles that match the hardware's supported patterns are cheap, but arbitrary permutations may need several instructions or a trip through shared memory. Horizontal operations like reductions and all/any also act as synchronization points within the warp, which constrains how freely the scheduler can overlap work.

We had to change the compiler to make the abstraction sound when interacting with other Rust features. As this is uncharted territory, we are not yet confident we have covered every case.

Future work

With SIMD, threads, and async all mapped onto the GPU, the natural next step is composing them: threads spreading work across warps, core::simd spreading data across the lanes within each warp, and async structuring the concurrency between them.

We are also interested in lowering matrix-shaped SIMD onto the GPU's tensor cores, and in auto-vectorizing ordinary scalar Rust loops into Simd operations so that code gets warp-level parallelism without being written against core::simd at all. As members of the Rust compiler team, we are keen to explore how much of this can happen in the compiler itself.

A vector representation shared across the CPU and the GPU is valuable, though it is not clear that today's portable SIMD types are the right basis for one. For one thing, they largely sit in a world of their own within the core and std APIs. More exploration is necessary.

Is VectorWare only focused on Rust?

The speed at which we are able to make progress on the GPU is a testament to the power of Rust's abstractions and ecosystem.

As a company, we understand that not everyone uses Rust. Our future products will support multiple programming languages and runtimes. However, we believe Rust is uniquely well suited to building high-performance, reliable GPU-native applications and that is what we are most excited about.

Follow us on X, Bluesky, LinkedIn, or subscribe to our blog to stay updated on our progress. We will be sharing more about our work in the coming months. You can also reach us at hello@vectorware.com.

blocks.html_en: As previously mentioned, the mapping rests on a single observation: a warp is a vector unit whose lanes are individually addressable. Once Simd<T, N> is laid out per lane, each family of operations has a direct warp-level counterpart.

sentences.en: As previously mentioned, the mapping rests on a single observation: a warp is a vector unit whose lanes are individually addressable.
sentences.zh: 如前所述，映射基于单个观察：扭曲是一个矢量单元，其通道可单独寻址。

sentences.en: Once Simd<T, N> is laid out per lane, each family of operations has a direct warp-level counterpart.
sentences.zh: 一旦 Simd<T, N> 按通道布局，每个操作系列都有一个直接的扭曲级别对应项。

blocks.html_en: SIMD elementwise operations are the easy case. Addition, multiplication, comparison, and the other lane-wise operators come from ordinary Rust trait implementations on Simd such as Add. The GPU runs them natively.

sentences.en: SIMD elementwise operations are the easy case.
sentences.zh: SIMD 元素运算是最简单的情况。

sentences.en: Addition, multiplication, comparison, and the other lane-wise operators come from ordinary Rust trait implementations on Simd such as Add.
sentences.zh: 加法、乘法、比较和其他通道运算符来自 Simd 上的普通 Rust 特征实现，例如 Add。

sentences.en: The GPU runs them natively.
sentences.zh: GPU 本地运行它们。

blocks.html_en: SIMD reductions such as reduce_sum and reduce_max combine every lane into a scalar. These use the GPU's warp shuffle instructions to exchange and combine values across lanes, producing the same scalar result in every lane.

sentences.en: SIMD reductions such as reduce_sum and reduce_max combine every lane into a scalar.
sentences.zh: SIMD 缩减（例如reduce_sum 和reduce_max）将每个通道组合成一个标量。

sentences.en: These use the GPU's warp shuffle instructions to exchange and combine values across lanes, producing the same scalar result in every lane.
sentences.zh: 它们使用 GPU 的 warp shuffle 指令跨通道交换和组合值，在每个通道中产生相同的标量结果。

blocks.html_en: SIMD cross-lane shuffles, such as simd_swizzle! and rotates, move elements between lanes. Because a SIMD lane is a GPU warp lane, these map onto the same warp shuffle primitives that make GPU lanes so good at exchanging data.

sentences.en: SIMD cross-lane shuffles, such as simd_swizzle!
sentences.zh: SIMD跨车道洗牌，例如simd_swizzle！

sentences.en: and rotates, move elements between lanes.
sentences.zh: 并旋转，在车道之间移动元素。

sentences.en: Because a SIMD lane is a GPU warp lane, these map onto the same warp shuffle primitives that make GPU lanes so good at exchanging data.
sentences.zh: 由于 SIMD 通道是 GPU warp 通道，因此它们映射到相同的 warp shuffle 原语，从而使 GPU 通道非常擅长交换数据。

blocks.html_en: SIMD masks map just as cleanly. A Mask<T, N> gives one predicate to each SIMD lane. Mask::select performs a selection in every warp lane. Horizontal mask queries such as any and all use GPU vote and ballot instructions.

sentences.en: SIMD masks map just as cleanly.
sentences.zh: SIMD 掩模映射同样清晰。

sentences.en: A Mask<T, N> gives one predicate to each SIMD lane.
sentences.zh: Mask<T, N> 为每个 SIMD 通道提供一个谓词。

sentences.en: Mask::select performs a selection in every warp lane.
sentences.zh: Mask::select 在每个扭曲通道中执行选择。

sentences.en: Horizontal mask queries such as any and all use GPU vote and ballot instructions.
sentences.zh: 水平掩码查询（例如any和all）使用GPU投票和选票指令。

blocks.html_en: Scalar values in the surrounding code, such as a loop counter or a constant, are computed identically by every lane and so are simply replicated across the warp just like in ordinary CUDA. This is the same uniform-versus-varying distinction that data-parallel languages like ISPC make explicit, except here it falls out of Rust's own types: a plain f32 is uniform, a Simd<f32, 32> is varying.

sentences.en: Scalar values in the surrounding code, such as a loop counter or a constant, are computed identically by every lane and so are simply replicated across the warp just like in ordinary CUDA.
sentences.zh: 周围代码中的标量值（例如循环计数器或常量）由每个通道进行相同的计算，因此可以像普通 CUDA 一样在扭曲中简单地复制。

sentences.en: This is the same uniform-versus-varying distinction that data-parallel languages like ISPC make explicit, except here it falls out of Rust's own types: a plain f32 is uniform, a Simd<f32, 32> is varying.
sentences.zh: 这与 ISPC 等数据并行语言所明确的一致与变化的区别相同，只不过这里它不属于 Rust 自己的类型：普通的 f32 是一致的，Simd<f32, 32> 是变化的。

sentences.en: Working with lanes
sentences.zh: 使用车道

blocks.html_en: The one place the abstraction and the hardware do not line up is lane count. On the CPU a Simd<T, N> allows any N from 1 through 64, but GPU hardware has a fixed width: 32 lanes on NVIDIA and 32 or 64 on AMD. The mapping is one to one only when N matches that width. A smaller N leaves some lanes idle while a larger N gives some or all lanes more than one element to process.

sentences.en: The one place the abstraction and the hardware do not line up is lane count.
sentences.zh: 抽象和硬件不一致的地方是通道数。

sentences.en: On the CPU a Simd<T, N> allows any N from 1 through 64, but GPU hardware has a fixed width: 32 lanes on NVIDIA and 32 or 64 on AMD.
sentences.zh: 在 CPU 上，Simd<T, N> 允许从 1 到 64 的任何 N，但 GPU 硬件具有固定宽度：NVIDIA 上有 32 个通道，AMD 上有 32 或 64 个通道。

sentences.en: The mapping is one to one only when N matches that width.
sentences.zh: 仅当 N 与该宽度匹配时，映射才是一对一的。

sentences.en: A smaller N leaves some lanes idle while a larger N gives some or all lanes more than one element to process.
sentences.zh: 较小的 N 会使某些通道闲置，而较大的 N 会使某些或所有通道有多个元素需要处理。

blocks.html_en: When there is more work than the warp is wide, we need a way to say which lanes do what. It helps to think of the warp as a small "machine" of its own: a fixed set of primitives for moving and combining data across lanes, plus invariants about which lanes are active and how much data each one holds. "Programming" it means placing work onto lanes within those rules.

sentences.en: When there is more work than the warp is wide, we need a way to say which lanes do what.
sentences.zh: 当工作量超过扭曲宽度时，我们需要一种方法来说明哪些通道做什么。

sentences.en: It helps to think of the warp as a small "machine" of its own: a fixed set of primitives for moving and combining data across lanes, plus invariants about which lanes are active and how much data each one holds.
sentences.zh: 它有助于将扭曲视为自己的小型“机器”：用于跨通道移动和组合数据的一组固定原语，以及有关哪些通道处于活动状态以及每个通道保存多少数据的不变量。

sentences.en: "Programming" it means placing work onto lanes within those rules.
sentences.zh: “规划”意味着将工作安排在这些规则范围内的车道上。

blocks.html_en: At VectorWare, we give that machine an IR. Rather than a standalone data structure, we encode it in Rust's type system using types, generics, const generics, and trait bounds. A program is composed of typed operations: ballots, shuffles, reductions, scans, gathers, scatters, atomics, and strip mining for vectors wider than the warp. Operands, execution shape, and capacity are typed too. Because the operations carry their shape in the types, many invalid programs cannot be constructed at all.

sentences.en: At VectorWare, we give that machine an IR.
sentences.zh: 在 VectorWare，我们为该机器提供了 IR。

sentences.en: Rather than a standalone data structure, we encode it in Rust's type system using types, generics, const generics, and trait bounds.
sentences.zh: 我们不是使用独立的数据结构，而是使用类型、泛型、常量泛型和特征边界将其编码在 Rust 的类型系统中。

sentences.en: A program is composed of typed operations: ballots, shuffles, reductions, scans, gathers, scatters, atomics, and strip mining for vectors wider than the warp.
sentences.zh: 程序由类型化操作组成：投票、洗牌、缩减、扫描、聚集、分散、原子操作以及对比扭曲更宽的向量进行条带挖掘。

sentences.en: Operands, execution shape, and capacity are typed too.
sentences.zh: 操作数、执行形状和容量也被键入。

sentences.en: Because the operations carry their shape in the types, many invalid programs cannot be constructed at all.
sentences.zh: 由于操作在类型中具有其形状，因此根本无法构造许多无效程序。

blocks.html_en: The IR needs no interpreter on the GPU. Each operation lowers straight to the corresponding instructions with zero cost over hand-written PTX. The same types let us run it on the CPU too. We built a reference interpreter that executes the IR deterministically, a kind of Miri for warp-lane programming. We use it to simulate GPU code and for differential testing.

sentences.en: The IR needs no interpreter on the GPU.
sentences.zh: IR 不需要 GPU 上的解释器。

sentences.en: Each operation lowers straight to the corresponding instructions with zero cost over hand-written PTX.
sentences.zh: 每个操作都直接下降到相应的指令，与手写 PTX 相比，成本为零。

sentences.en: The same types let us run it on the CPU too.
sentences.zh: 相同的类型也让我们可以在 CPU 上运行它。

sentences.en: We built a reference interpreter that executes the IR deterministically, a kind of Miri for warp-lane programming.
sentences.zh: 我们构建了一个参考解释器，可以确定性地执行 IR，这是一种用于扭曲通道编程的 Miri。

sentences.en: We use it to simulate GPU code and for differential testing.
sentences.zh: 我们用它来模拟 GPU 代码并进行差异测试。

blocks.html_en: Our work targets NVIDIA today, but nothing here is CUDA specific. AMD wavefronts and Vulkan subgroups expose similar primitives and semantics. The IR itself is architecture-agnostic Rust.

sentences.en: Our work targets NVIDIA today, but nothing here is CUDA specific.
sentences.zh: 我们今天的工作目标是 NVIDIA，但这里没有任何内容是针对 CUDA 的。

sentences.en: AMD wavefronts and Vulkan subgroups expose similar primitives and semantics.
sentences.zh: AMD 波前和 Vulkan 子组公开了类似的基元和语义。

sentences.en: The IR itself is architecture-agnostic Rust.
sentences.zh: IR 本身是与架构无关的 Rust。

blocks.html_en: Benefits

sentences.en: Benefits
sentences.zh: 好处

blocks.html_en: The same source runs on the CPU and the GPU. Code and libraries that already use portable SIMD become candidates for GPU execution without a rewrite.

sentences.en: The same source runs on the CPU and the GPU.
sentences.zh: 相同的源在 CPU 和 GPU 上运行。

sentences.en: Code and libraries that already use portable SIMD become candidates for GPU execution without a rewrite.
sentences.zh: 已经使用可移植 SIMD 的代码和库无需重写即可成为 GPU 执行的候选者。

blocks.html_en: Unmodified CPU code can use GPU lane-level parallelism. GPU-aware code can still go further by using core::arch intrinsics that map directly to PTX.

sentences.en: Unmodified CPU code can use GPU lane-level parallelism.
sentences.zh: 未经修改的 CPU 代码可以使用 GPU 通道级并行性。

sentences.en: GPU-aware code can still go further by using core::arch intrinsics that map directly to PTX.
sentences.zh: GPU 感知代码仍然可以通过使用直接映射到 PTX 的 core::arch 内在函数走得更远。

blocks.html_en: A Simd<T, N> is an ordinary owned value. The borrow checker, lifetimes, and type checking apply to it exactly as they do on the CPU. We are not adding a GPU-specific vector type or a new set of annotations. We are mapping Rust's existing portable SIMD onto the GPU's native execution model. At VectorWare, we are making GPUs behave like a normal Rust platform.

sentences.en: A Simd<T, N> is an ordinary owned value.
sentences.zh: Simd<T, N> 是一个普通的自有值。

sentences.en: The borrow checker, lifetimes, and type checking apply to it exactly as they do on the CPU.
sentences.zh: 借用检查器、生命周期和类型检查对其的应用与在 CPU 上的应用完全相同。

sentences.en: We are not adding a GPU-specific vector type or a new set of annotations.
sentences.zh: 我们不会添加特定于 GPU 的矢量类型或一组新的注释。

sentences.en: We are mapping Rust's existing portable SIMD onto the GPU's native execution model.
sentences.zh: 我们正在将 Rust 现有的可移植 SIMD 映射到 GPU 的本机执行模型。

sentences.en: At VectorWare, we are making GPUs behave like a normal Rust platform.
sentences.zh: 在 VectorWare，我们正在让 GPU 表现得像一个普通的 Rust 平台。

blocks.html_en: Downsides

sentences.en: Downsides
sentences.zh: 缺点

blocks.html_en: Portable SIMD is still unstable in Rust. It requires the nightly #![feature(portable_simd)], and its surface may change before it stabilizes.

sentences.en: Portable SIMD is still unstable in Rust.
sentences.zh: 可移植 SIMD 在 Rust 中仍然不稳定。

sentences.en: It requires the nightly #![feature(portable_simd)], and its surface may change before it stabilizes.
sentences.zh: 它需要夜间 #![feature(portable_simd)]，并且其表面在稳定之前可能会发生变化。

blocks.html_en: Vectors narrower than the warp leave lanes idle, and vectors wider than the warp turn each operation into more instructions. The abstraction is only zero cost when the vector width matches the number of warp lanes.

sentences.en: Vectors narrower than the warp leave lanes idle, and vectors wider than the warp turn each operation into more instructions.
sentences.zh: 比扭曲更窄的向量会使通道闲置，而比扭曲更宽的向量将每个操作转化为更多指令。

sentences.en: The abstraction is only zero cost when the vector width matches the number of warp lanes.
sentences.zh: 当矢量宽度与扭曲通道的数量匹配时，抽象仅是零成本。

blocks.html_en: Not every cross-lane operation maps to an efficient warp instruction. Shuffles that match the hardware's supported patterns are cheap, but arbitrary permutations may need several instructions or a trip through shared memory. Horizontal operations like reductions and all/any also act as synchronization points within the warp, which constrains how freely the scheduler can overlap work.

sentences.en: Not every cross-lane operation maps to an efficient warp instruction.
sentences.zh: 并非每个跨通道操作都映射到有效的扭曲指令。

sentences.en: Shuffles that match the hardware's supported patterns are cheap, but arbitrary permutations may need several instructions or a trip through shared memory.
sentences.zh: 与硬件支持的模式相匹配的随机播放很便宜，但任意排列可能需要多条指令或遍历共享内存。

sentences.en: Horizontal operations like reductions and all/any also act as synchronization points within the warp, which constrains how freely the scheduler can overlap work.
sentences.zh: 诸如缩减和全部/任意之类的水平操作也充当扭曲内的同步点，这限制了调度程序可以自由地重叠工作。

blocks.html_en: We had to change the compiler to make the abstraction sound when interacting with other Rust features. As this is uncharted territory, we are not yet confident we have covered every case.

sentences.en: We had to change the compiler to make the abstraction sound when interacting with other Rust features.
sentences.zh: 我们必须更改编译器，才能在与其他 Rust 功能交互时使抽象听起来更清晰。

sentences.en: As this is uncharted territory, we are not yet confident we have covered every case.
sentences.zh: 由于这是一个未知领域，我们尚不确信我们已经涵盖了所有案例。

blocks.html_en: Future work

sentences.en: Future work
sentences.zh: 未来的工作

blocks.html_en: With SIMD, threads, and async all mapped onto the GPU, the natural next step is composing them: threads spreading work across warps, core::simd spreading data across the lanes within each warp, and async structuring the concurrency between them.

sentences.en: With SIMD, threads, and async all mapped onto the GPU, the natural next step is composing them: threads spreading work across warps, core::simd spreading data across the lanes within each warp, and async structuring the concurrency between them.
sentences.zh: 将 SIMD、线程和异步全部映射到 GPU 后，自然的下一步就是组合它们：线程在 warp 之间分散工作，core::simd 在每个 warp 内的通道上分散数据，以及 async 构建它们之间的并发性。

blocks.html_en: We are also interested in lowering matrix-shaped SIMD onto the GPU's tensor cores, and in auto-vectorizing ordinary scalar Rust loops into Simd operations so that code gets warp-level parallelism without being written against core::simd at all. As members of the Rust compiler team, we are keen to explore how much of this can happen in the compiler itself.

sentences.en: We are also interested in lowering matrix-shaped SIMD onto the GPU's tensor cores, and in auto-vectorizing ordinary scalar Rust loops into Simd operations so that code gets warp-level parallelism without being written against core::simd at all.
sentences.zh: 我们还对将矩阵形状的 SIMD 降低到 GPU 的张量核心上，以及将普通标量 Rust 循环自动矢量化为 Simd 操作感兴趣，以便代码获得扭曲级并行性，而根本不需要针对 core::simd 进行编写。

sentences.en: As members of the Rust compiler team, we are keen to explore how much of this can happen in the compiler itself.
sentences.zh: 作为 Rust 编译器团队的成员，我们热衷于探索编译器本身会发生多少这种情况。

blocks.html_en: A vector representation shared across the CPU and the GPU is valuable, though it is not clear that today's portable SIMD types are the right basis for one. For one thing, they largely sit in a world of their own within the core and std APIs. More exploration is necessary.

sentences.en: A vector representation shared across the CPU and the GPU is valuable, though it is not clear that today's portable SIMD types are the right basis for one.
sentences.zh: 在 CPU 和 GPU 之间共享的矢量表示很有价值，尽管目前尚不清楚当今的便携式 SIMD 类型是否是其正确的基础。

sentences.en: For one thing, they largely sit in a world of their own within the core and std APIs.
sentences.zh: 一方面，它们很大程度上位于核心和标准 API 中自己的世界中。

sentences.en: More exploration is necessary.
sentences.zh: 需要更多的探索。

blocks.html_en: Is VectorWare only focused on Rust?

sentences.en: Is VectorWare only focused on Rust?
sentences.zh: VectorWare 只专注于 Rust 吗？

blocks.html_en: The speed at which we are able to make progress on the GPU is a testament to the power of Rust's abstractions and ecosystem.

sentences.en: The speed at which we are able to make progress on the GPU is a testament to the power of Rust's abstractions and ecosystem.
sentences.zh: 我们在 GPU 上取得进展的速度证明了 Rust 抽象和生态系统的力量。

blocks.html_en: As a company, we understand that not everyone uses Rust. Our future products will support multiple programming languages and runtimes. However, we believe Rust is uniquely well suited to building high-performance, reliable GPU-native applications and that is what we are most excited about.

迂腐模式：关

GPU 代码现在可以使用 Rust 的便携式 SIMD。 我们分享实现方法以及它为 GPU 编程带来的好处。

在 VectorWare，我们正在打造第一家 GPU 原生软件公司。 今天，我们很高兴地宣布我们可以在 GPU 上成功使用 Rust 的便携式 SIMD (core::simd)。 这一里程碑标志着我们朝着让开发人员能够使用熟悉的 Rust 抽象来编写复杂的高性能应用程序，充分利用 GPU 硬件的全部功能的愿景迈出了重要一步。

线程下方的并行度

当我们将 Rust 线​​程引入 GPU 时，我们将每个 std::thread 映射到 GPU warp。 这让我们可以在 GPU 上运行许多并发线程，但不使用每个线程/扭曲中的并行通道。

在 CPU 上，线程内并行性的抽象是 SIMD。 一条指令对打包到向量单元中的多个数据元素进行操作：其中标量代码将两个数字相加，SIMD 加法采用两个向量（例如，八个 f32 值）并一次生成八个和。 这种数据并行性位于单个线程内，低于操作系统调度任何内容的级别。

CPU 线程SIMD op012N⋯SIMD 通道CPU 线程

Rust 的便携式 SIMD

从历史上看，用 Rust 编写 SIMD 意味着在 core::arch 中获取特定于架构的供应商内在函数，例如 x86-64 上的 _mm256_add_ps 或 Arm 上的 vaddq_f32。 这些内在函数特定于单个指令集，因此在多个体系结构上运行的程序需要为每个体系结构单独实现。

相反，Rust 的可移植 SIMD 在这些内在函数之上添加了一个抽象层。 它提供了一个通用类型 Simd<T, N> ，表示由 N 个 T 类型元素组成的向量。 程序针对 Simd 编写一次算术、比较、归约和通道洗牌，然后编译器将它们降低为目标 CPU 具有的任何向量指令。

在 VectorWare，我们意识到 GPU 只是便携式 SIMD 目标的又一个矢量硬件。 额外的好处是，便携式 SIMD 存在于核心而不是 std 中，它甚至不需要我们为 GPU 带来的 std 支持。

SIMT 是 SIMD

GPU 在 NVIDIA 称为 SIMT（即单指令多线程）的模型中执行。 Warp 发出一条指令，其 32 个通道中的每一个都根据自己的数据运行该指令。 对许多数据元素进行操作的一条指令正是 SIMD 的含义，SIMT 添加的每通道寻址不会改变这一点。 扭曲是一个宽向量单元，便携式 SIMD 向量直接映射到该单元。

CPU线程012N⋯SIMD通道≈GPU warp012N⋯warp通道

例如，Simd<i16, 32> 为 warp 的 32 个通道中的每一个提供一个 i16 元素，并且添加两个这样的向量将编译为单个 warp 指令，其中每个通道立即添加其元素。

CPUlet a: Simd<i16, 32> = [1, 1, 1, ..., 1];let b: Simd<i16, 32> = [2, 2, 2, ..., 2];let c = a + b;编译为vpaddw %zmm2, %zmm1, %zmm0a0+b0lane 0a1+b1lane 1a2+b2lane 2a31+b31lane 31⋯println!("{c:?}");

GPUlet a: Simd<i16, 32> = [1, 1, 1, ..., 1];let b: Simd<i16, 32> = [2, 2, 2, ..., 2];let c = a + b;编译为add.s16 %rs3, %rs1, %rs2;a0+b0lane 0a1+b1lane 1a2+b2lane 2a31+b31lane 31⋯println!("{c:?}");

这个新的映射完善了我们早期工作中的并行层次结构。 在 CPU 上，线程包含 SIMD 通道，而在 GPU 上，我们的 std::thread 是一个扭曲，其硬件通道起着相同的作用。 在这两种情况下，core::simd 驱动这些通道。

CPU⋯线程0012N⋯线程1012N⋯线程N012N⋯SIMD通道≈GPU⋯经线0012N⋯经线1012N⋯经线N012N⋯经线通道

世界首创：GPU 上的 core::simd

与我们之前的文章一样，这很难直观地显示，因为代码是普通的 Rust。 相同的 core::simd 类型在笔记本电脑上降低到 x86-64 SIMD，降低到 GPU 上的扭曲操作，而无需更改源。

这里我们定义了一个小型的可移植 SIMD 例程并从 main 中调用它。 它运用了模型的核心功能：元素运算、生成通道掩码的比较、由该掩码驱动的选择以及跨通道的水平缩减。

入口点是一个普通的 fn main，没有特定于 GPU 的注释。 我们的工具链将其编译为 GPU 内核，并使用我们的 std 支持从设备打印结果。

下面是在 GPU 上运行的程序的记录，产生与在 CPU 上运行完全相同的输出。

执行

如前所述，映射基于单个观察：扭曲是一个矢量单元，其通道可单独寻址。 一旦 Simd<T, N> 按通道布局，每个操作系列都有一个直接的扭曲级别对应项。

SIMD 元素运算是最简单的情况。 加法、乘法、比较和其他通道运算符来自 Simd 上的普通 Rust 特征实现，例如 Add。 GPU 本地运行它们。

SIMD 缩减（例如reduce_sum 和reduce_max）将每个通道组合成一个标量。 它们使用 GPU 的 warp shuffle 指令跨通道交换和组合值，在每个通道中产生相同的标量结果。

SIMD跨车道洗牌，例如simd_swizzle！ 并旋转，在车道之间移动元素。 由于 SIMD 通道是 GPU warp 通道，因此它们映射到相同的 warp shuffle 原语，从而使 GPU 通道非常擅长交换数据。

SIMD 掩模映射同样清晰。 Mask<T, N> 为每个 SIMD 通道提供一个谓词。 Mask::select 在每个扭曲通道中执行选择。 水平掩码查询（例如any和all）使用GPU投票和选票指令。

周围代码中的标量值（例如循环计数器或常量）由每个通道进行相同的计算，因此可以像普通 CUDA 一样在扭曲中简单地复制。 这与 ISPC 等数据并行语言所明确的一致与变化的区别相同，只不过这里它不属于 Rust 自己的类型：普通的 f32 是一致的，Simd<f32, 32> 是变化的。

使用车道

抽象和硬件不一致的地方是通道数。 在 CPU 上，Simd<T, N> 允许从 1 到 64 的任何 N，但 GPU 硬件具有固定宽度：NVIDIA 上有 32 个通道，AMD 上有 32 或 64 个通道。 仅当 N 与该宽度匹配时，映射才是一对一的。 较小的 N 会使某些通道闲置，而较大的 N 会使某些或所有通道有多个元素需要处理。

当工作量超过扭曲宽度时，我们需要一种方法来说明哪些通道做什么。 它有助于将扭曲视为自己的小型“机器”：用于跨通道移动和组合数据的一组固定原语，以及有关哪些通道处于活动状态以及每个通道保存多少数据的不变量。 “规划”意味着将工作安排在这些规则范围内的车道上。

在 VectorWare，我们为该机器提供了 IR。 我们不是使用独立的数据结构，而是使用类型、泛型、常量泛型和特征边界将其编码在 Rust 的类型系统中。 程序由类型化操作组成：投票、洗牌、缩减、扫描、聚集、分散、原子操作以及对比扭曲更宽的向量进行条带挖掘。 操作数、执行形状和容量也被键入。 由于操作在类型中具有其形状，因此根本无法构造许多无效程序。

IR 不需要 GPU 上的解释器。 每个操作都直接下降到相应的指令，与手写 PTX 相比，成本为零。 相同的类型也让我们可以在 CPU 上运行它。 我们构建了一个参考解释器，可以确定性地执行 IR，这是一种用于扭曲通道编程的 Miri。 我们用它来模拟 GPU 代码并进行差异测试。

我们今天的工作目标是 NVIDIA，但这里没有任何内容是针对 CUDA 的。 AMD 波前和 Vulkan 子组公开了类似的基元和语义。 IR 本身是与架构无关的 Rust。

好处

相同的源在 CPU 和 GPU 上运行。 已经使用可移植 SIMD 的代码和库无需重写即可成为 GPU 执行的候选者。

未经修改的 CPU 代码可以使用 GPU 通道级并行性。 GPU 感知代码仍然可以通过使用直接映射到 PTX 的 core::arch 内在函数走得更远。

Simd<T, N> 是一个普通的自有值。 借用检查器、生命周期和类型检查对其的应用与在 CPU 上的应用完全相同。 我们不会添加特定于 GPU 的矢量类型或一组新的注释。 我们正在将 Rust 现有的可移植 SIMD 映射到 GPU 的本机执行模型。 在 VectorWare，我们正在让 GPU 表现得像一个普通的 Rust 平台。

缺点

可移植 SIMD 在 Rust 中仍然不稳定。 它需要夜间 #![feature(portable_simd)]，并且其表面在稳定之前可能会发生变化。

比扭曲更窄的向量会使通道闲置，而比扭曲更宽的向量将每个操作转化为更多指令。 当矢量宽度与扭曲通道的数量匹配时，抽象仅是零成本。

并非每个跨通道操作都映射到有效的扭曲指令。 与硬件支持的模式相匹配的随机播放很便宜，但任意排列可能需要多条指令或遍历共享内存。 诸如缩减和全部/任意之类的水平操作也充当扭曲内的同步点，这限制了调度程序可以自由地重叠工作。

我们必须更改编译器，才能在与其他 Rust 功能交互时使抽象听起来更清晰。 由于这是一个未知领域，我们尚不确信我们已经涵盖了所有案例。

未来的工作

将 SIMD、线程和异步全部映射到 GPU 后，自然的下一步就是组合它们：线程在 warp 之间分散工作，core::simd 在每个 warp 内的通道上分散数据，以及 async 构建它们之间的并发性。

我们还对将矩阵形状的 SIMD 降低到 GPU 的张量核心上，以及将普通标量 Rust 循环自动矢量化为 Simd 操作感兴趣，以便代码获得扭曲级并行性，而根本不需要针对 core::simd 进行编写。 作为 Rust 编译器团队的成员，我们热衷于探索编译器本身会发生多少这种情况。

在 CPU 和 GPU 之间共享的矢量表示很有价值，尽管目前尚不清楚当今的便携式 SIMD 类型是否是其正确的基础。 一方面，它们很大程度上位于核心和标准 API 中自己的世界中。 需要更多的探索。

VectorWare 只专注于 Rust 吗？

我们在 GPU 上取得进展的速度证明了 Rust 抽象和生态系统的力量。

作为一家公司，我们知道并不是每个人都使用 Rust。 我们未来的产品将支持多种编程语言和运行时。 然而，我们相信 Rust 非常适合构建高性能、可靠的 GPU 原生应用程序，这也是我们最兴奋的地方。
